data.text: Generated pages on Tailwind CDN: preflight resets h1/h2 to body size — any heading without an explicit text-[px] class silently collapses. Knowledge on generated-page authoring does not name this trap; 3/6 rebuild sites hit it in one day.

VR baselines captured without a scroll-through settle penalize a rebuild for being MORE complete than the capture (lazy regions render black in the baseline). visual-regression knowledge does not cover baseline honesty for lazy-loading pages.
Rebuild-from-capture craft: crops must contain ONLY artwork, never headlines/CTAs (HTML renders those; text inside a crop = double text). No knowledge file owns rebuild/clone-adapt craft.

Multi-site lab/dogfood workspaces have no layout convention — 3 generations of dirs accumulated and builder agents dumped scripts at the root until a manifest README was hand-written. Candidate: lab workspace scaffold + layout rule.

Executor sessions can claim work happened without a diff: two fix rounds reported done while file state was unchanged. Knowledge lacks a verify-by-artifact discipline (mtime/diff/render evidence before accepting any done-claim).

Ghost-region taste principle (from lab curator sweep 2026-07-15, recurred 4/7 rebuilds: apple black bento tiles, clickhouse near-black stack/logo_strip crops, cohere literal placeholder boxes, linear empty glow section). A rebuild/design must NEVER ship a bordered or backgrounded region larger than ~200x200px with no artwork and no useful innerText — an empty framed box reads as broken/unfinished, worse than no box. Rule: fill it with the real crop, replace with HTML content (chip grid, text), or COLLAPSE the section. A large empty region is worse than a small dense one. Corollary: a crop whose mean luma is within ~5% of the section background is effectively empty even if the file exists.

Rebuild/clone-adapt/design-from-URL delivery ships screenshot-crops when the source already serves sharp originals (inline-SVG logos, 1560x1248+ product-UI rasters) sitting unused in the mirror/harvest. Need a delivery-assets standard + resolver + avoidable-screenshot-crop lint. Owner: get original assets, not screenshots like a noob.

No knowledge file owns rebuild/clone-adapt craft end to end (probe -> asset-resolve -> spec -> build -> masked-diff verify -> ledger). Candidate consolidated workflow knowledge, feeding /ui:from-url and /ui:from-design-md.

Figma live-sync live dogfood (VSF, 21 real events): the wire works end-to-end (capture→log→panel→Sync→apply→cursor) but the registry did NOT change. Reason: the registry stores structure+tokens+markup, NOT raw visual values; the common edits (padding/height/x/y/width/visible/layoutAlign/componentProperties) map to no registry field, so apply is a no-op for them. Only name is structural. New components → pending (no markup). Owner intuition (my edits flow in) wants a component MIRROR, but capturing changedProp NAMES is not enough — need per-component full re-export (markup+tokens) on change. Decision: live-sync tracks STRUCTURE only, or MIRRORS the component (heavier).

Figma live-sync apply advanced the cursor past 21 events that produced ZERO registry writes. Panel says N changes Synced but nothing landed → misleading (no-silent-caps flavor). Apply/panel should report what actually landed (added/updated/deprecated counts that changed the registry), not raw event count; processed != applied.

Spec 019 benchmark evidence: a deterministic floor-clean artifact shipped a render-only duplicate-diagram defect. Floor pass and subjective quality verdict must remain separate; error findings block, while warning findings require an explicit disposition rather than being misreported as failures. Provenance: specs/019-model-routing-benchmark/benchmark-result.md#demonstrated-findings.

Spec 019 benchmark evidence: independent cross-family critics produced materially divergent taste rankings across both briefs. Divergent verdicts are an unresolved proxy state and must be surfaced separately rather than averaged into a consensus no critic holds; owner adjudication is required for taste graduation. Provenance: specs/019-model-routing-benchmark/benchmark-result.md#demonstrated-findings.

Spec 019 benchmark evidence: an invalid shallow run produced a confident absolute 8.71 verdict despite skipping the real generation and critique-repair flow. Axis scores may diagnose one artifact, but cross-candidate taste verdicts need blind rendered comparison and may remain unresolved. Provenance: specs/019-model-routing-benchmark/benchmark-result.md#demonstrated-findings.

Spec 019 narrow routing evidence: from the same frozen direction on two briefs, a stronger same-family coder produced no separable quality gain over the cheaper coder. This supports evaluating coder escalation after repeated repair failure, but does not support a general cheap-first doctrine for direction or judging. Provenance: specs/019-model-routing-benchmark/benchmark-result.md#demonstrated-findings.

Spec 019 benchmark evidence: model and routing winners changed with judge family and case, so a model-winner label is not a durable owner preference. Any future preference claim requires blind owner provenance and evidence counts; until then routing outcomes remain benchmark hypotheses, not design memory. Provenance: specs/019-model-routing-benchmark/benchmark-result.md#demonstrated-findings.

Owner blind verdict (spec 019, 2026-07-24): the owner blind-ranked 2 briefs x 7 arms (Cadence dark dev-tool, Haven light secrets-vault), rendered live and anonymized, Approve/Reject per candidate, de-anonymized after. Approve/Reject was perfectly separated by ONE variable: whether Fable set the creative direction. Approved on BOTH briefs: A0 bare, A1 all-Sonnet (Sonnet direction), A5 Sonnet-direction+cross-judge. Rejected on BOTH briefs: A2/A3/A4/A6 = every Fable-directed arm, across Sonnet, Opus, and Codex coders (coder tier/family did not rescue). This supplies the blind-owner provenance the e15 guardrail required, so the anti-Fable-direction signal is now owner-grounded, not proxy; it corroborates the pilot. DESIGN:OS itself is not implicated (2 of 3 approved arms run the full pipeline with Sonnet direction). Scope limits: n=2 briefs, 1 judged run per arm, single owner session, Approve/Reject only. Directional owner-taste evidence, NOT a promoted routing rule: any de-prioritization of Fable direction or promotion of Sonnet direction still requires the librarian veto chain + human merge. No deterministic gate threshold changed. Provenance: specs/019-model-routing-benchmark/benchmark-result.md#owner-blind-verdict-2026-07-24.

Owner feedback on the spec-019 blind benchmark (2026-07-24), verbatim: 'I blindly check the design, but im voting based on the carefully implement and keen on detail, not just the layout alone. I think some of them still to simple. But it show huge potential that design os work on almost every model.' Interpretation (owner-stated, do not overread): (1) the blind Approve/Reject (e16) was judged on CAREFUL IMPLEMENTATION and keen fine detail = craft, NOT layout alone; read e16 as a craft/detail judgment, not a layout verdict and not a pro/anti-direction routing verdict. (2) Several outputs still read as too simple. (3) The cross-model baseline shows strong potential that DESIGN:OS works across almost every tested model (robustness signal). Boundaries: no top-2/bottom-2 ranking is implied, no arm is de-anonymized by this note, and NO routing winner is graduated from it. Provenance: specs/019-model-routing-benchmark/benchmark-result.md#owner-feedback-on-evaluation-basis-2026-07-24.

Owner blind ORDINAL ranking (spec 019 Panel 2, 2026-07-25) — a NEW run, does NOT pool with panel-1/e16 (different builds, reconstructed briefs, ordinal not Approve/Reject, 3 arms not 7). Preregistered in panel-2-RUN-PLAN.md before any candidate existed. 3 arms x 2 briefs, rendered live at desktop width, anonymized C1-C3/H1-H3, de-anonymized after voting. RESULT: Cadence A5>A1>A0; Haven A5>A0>A1. A5 (Sonnet direction + CROSS-FAMILY Codex judge) first on BOTH briefs. PRIMARY QUESTION UNRESOLVED: does DESIGN:OS beat bare? A0 bare came 3rd on Cadence but 2nd on Haven, beating full-pipeline A1 — per the preregistered reading this is the split case, recorded as NO owner-grounded separation, NOT a pipeline win. LOAD-BEARING FINDING: A1 held a perfect machine floor on both briefs (taste-lint 0, all gates clean) and ranked 2nd and 3rd, while A5 shipped 8 advisory warnings on Cadence and won it — the first OWNER-GROUNDED support for finding 1, a deterministic floor is not a quality verdict. Behavioural split measured across both build sets: self-judge zeroes the machine floor (0/0), cross-judge leaves advisory warnings standing (13/20 control, 8/0 here) and instead fixes what another family flags (dead CTAs, sub-AA contrast, 390px overlap, unmanaged focus). Owner preferred the latter twice. Imagery is NOT a craft proxy: the Cadence winner generated ZERO images (intentional no-image on the asset ladder, reasoned) and beat two arms that each shipped one. LIMITS: n=2 briefs, 1 build/arm, single session, reconstructed briefs, judged on craft/detail per the 2026-07-24 basis. No routing default, no model winner, no knowledge change authorized; librarian veto chain + human merge still gate promotion.

PROVENANCE CORRECTION for e18. e18 (owner blind ordinal ranking, spec 019 Panel 2, 2026-07-25) was recorded with malformed refs — a JSON array string was passed to --refs, which takes COMMA-SEPARATED ids, so its provenance stored as ["[\"e15\"","\"e16\"","\"e17\"]"] instead of e15,e16,e17. The ledger is append-only and never hand-edited, so e18 stands as written and THIS event carries its correct provenance: e18 draws from e15 (the blind-owner guardrail), e16 (the panel-1 Approve/Reject verdict) and e17 (the owner too-simple craft feedback). e18 content is unchanged and remains valid; only its refs edge was broken. Flag note for future use: ui memory record --refs is comma-separated; only ui memory consolidate --refs takes JSON.
